35115-wine-water-and-song.title: And Song
35115-wine-water-and-song.creator: G. K. Chesterton
35115-wine-water-and-song.description: A book by G. K. Chesterton. George he was for England,   And before he killed the dragon   He drank a pint of English ale   Out of an English flagon. For though he fast right readily   In hair-shirt or in mail,   It isn't safe to give him cakes   Unless you give him ale.

arxiv-2104-06334.title: On the asymptotic behavior of cocycles over flows
arxiv-2104-06334.creator: Maxim E. Lipatov
arxiv-2104-06334.description: Abstract In 1968, V.I. Oseledets formulated the question of convergence in the Birkhoff theorem and the multiplicative ergodic theorem for measurable cocycles over flows under the condition of integrability for each individual t t . A.M. Stepin and the author established (2016) the convergence along subsets of time of density 1.

arxiv-2112-14224.title: Perturbations of Parabolic Equations and Diffusion Processes with Degeneration: Boundary Problems, Metastability, and Homogenization
arxiv-2112-14224.creator: Mark Freidlinlabel=e1]mif@umd.edu, Leonid Koralovlabel=e2]koralov@umd.edu
arxiv-2112-14224.description: Abstract We study diffusion processes that are stopped or reflected on the boundary of a domain. The generator of the process is assumed to contain two parts: the main part that degenerates on the boundary in a direction orthogonal to the boundary and a small non-degenerate perturbation.

arxiv-2206-01446.title: Modified Bivariate Weibull Distribution Allowing Instantaneous and Early Failures
arxiv-2206-01446.creator: Sumangal Bhattacharya, Ishapathik Das, Muralidharan Kunnummal
arxiv-2206-01446.description: Abstract In reliability and life data analysis, the Weibull distribution is widely used to accommodate more data characteristics by changing the values of the parameters. We frequently observe many zeros or close to zero data points in reliability and life testing experiments. We call this phenomenon a nearly instantaneous failure.

arxiv-2208-12798.title: Electrical networks and the Grove algebra Thanks: T.L. was supported by Grant No. DMS-1953852 from the National Science Foundation.
arxiv-2208-12798.creator: Yibo Gao, Thomas Lam, Zixuan Xu
arxiv-2208-12798.description: Abstract . We study the ring of regular functions on the space of planar electrical networks, which we coin the grove algebra . This algebra is an electrical analogue of the Plücker ring studied classically in invariant theory. We develop the combinatorics of double groves to study the grove algebra, and find a quadratic Gröbner basis for the grove ideal.

arxiv-2209-14599.title: Online pseudo labeling for polyp segmentation with momentum networks
arxiv-2209-14599.creator: Toan Pham Van, Linh Bao Doan, Thanh Tung Nguyen, Duc Trung Tran, Quan Van Nguyen, Dinh Viet Sang
arxiv-2209-14599.description: Abstract Semantic segmentation is an essential task in developing medical image diagnosis systems. However, building an annotated medical dataset is expensive. Thus, semi-supervised methods are significant in this circumstance. In semi-supervised learning, the quality of labels plays a crucial role in model performance.

arxiv-2306-09906.title: Correlation Clustering of Bird Sounds
arxiv-2306-09906.creator: David Stein Bjoern Andres
arxiv-2306-09906.description: Abstract Bird sound classification is the task of relating any sound recording to those species of bird that can be heard in the recording. Here, we study bird sound clustering, the task of deciding for any pair of sound recordings whether the same species of bird can be heard in both.

arxiv-2406-18679.title: Speakers Unembedded: Embedding-free Approach to Long-form Neural Diarization
arxiv-2406-18679.creator: Xiang Li, Vivek Govindan, Rohit Paturi, Sundararajan Srinivasan
arxiv-2406-18679.description: Abstract End-to-end neural diarization (EEND) models offer significant improvements over traditional embedding-based Speaker Diarization (SD) approaches but falls short on generalizing to long-form audio with large number of speakers. EEND-vector-clustering method mitigates this by combining local EEND with global clustering of speaker embeddings from local windows, but this requires an additional speaker embedding framework alongside the EEND module.

arxiv-2509-08658.title: How to simulate magic state cultivation with around 8 8 Clifford terms on average
arxiv-2509-08658.creator: Kwok Ho Wan, Zhenghao Zhong
arxiv-2509-08658.description: Abstract Building upon [arXiv:2509.01224], we present a sketch on how to simulate the non-Clifford d = 5 d=5 magic state cultivation circuits [arXiv:2409.17595] with a sum of ≈ 8 \approx 8 Clifford ZX-diagrams on average, at 0.1 % 0.1\% noise.

arxiv-2510-13656.title: Rebalancing with Calibrated Sub-classes (RCS): A Statistical Fusion-based Framework for Robust Imbalanced Classification across Modalities
arxiv-2510-13656.creator: Priyobrata Mondal, Faizanuddin Ansari, Swagatam Das
arxiv-2510-13656.description: Abstract Class imbalance, where certain classes have insufficient data, poses a critical challenge for robust classification, often biasing models toward majority classes. Distribution calibration offers a promising avenue to address this by estimating more accurate class distributions. In this work, we propose Rebalancing with Calibrated Sub-classes (RCS) — a novel distribution calibration framework for robust imbalanced classification.

pmc-10656417.title: Evaluating the effects of brain injury, disease and tasks on cognitive fatigue
pmc-10656417.creator: Glenn R Wylie, Helen M Genova, Bing Yao, Nancy Chiaravalloti, Cristina A F Román, Brian M Sandroff, John DeLuca
pmc-10656417.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Because cognitive fatigue (CF) is common and debilitating following brain injury or disease we investigated the relationships among CF, behavioral performance, and cerebral activation within and across populations by combining the data from two cross-sectional studies. Individuals with multiple sclerosis (MS) were included to model CF resulting from neurological disease; individuals who had sustained a traumatic brain injury (TBI) were included to model CF resulting from neurological insult; both groups were compared with a control group (Controls).

pmc-11396208.title: The Effect of Long-Term Aging on the Microstructure and Properties of a Novel Nickel-Based Powder Superalloy FGH4113A
pmc-11396208.creator: Jiangying Xiong, Chao Yin, Chong Wang, Ganjiang Feng, Jianzheng Guo, Hideki Hosoda
pmc-11396208.description: This study investigates the microstructural evolution and its effect on the fatigue performance of a novel nickel-based powder superalloy FGH4113A (WZ-A3) after long-term aging at 760 °C and 815 °C. The results show that long-term aging both at 760 °C and 815 °C has no significant effect on the grain size and morphology of the alloy.

pmc-11627207.title: Controlled to uncontrolled drug use: The impact of Covid-19 among young people in the UK
pmc-11627207.creator: Hayley Murray
pmc-11627207.description: The Covid-19 pandemic lockdown had a profound impact on British young adults’ drug using lives. Overnight, participants found themselves unable to access the protective mechanisms, specifically peer groups and routines on which they had come to rely to control and maintain pleasure with their drug use.

pmc-11716600.title: Accounting for White Matter Uptake Improves Between‐Tracer Agreement in Amyloid PET
pmc-11716600.creator: Yinghua Chen, Hillary D Protas, Ji Luo, Shan Li, Javad Sohankar, Valentina Ghisays, Wendy Lee, Teresa Wu, Eric M Reiman, Kewei Chen, Yi Su
pmc-11716600.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundDifferent PET tracers can be used to measure neuritic amyloid plaque deposition in human brain. While mean cortical‐to‐cerebellar standard uptake value ratios (SUVRs) generated using different radiotracer methods can be transformed into Centiloid measurements to facilitate comparisons among the resulting amyloid plaque measurements, the level of agreement as measured by the strength of the correlation between the measurements does not change.

pmc-12467538.title: Robust Pt/Au Composite Nanostructures for Abiotic Glucose Sensing
pmc-12467538.creator: Asghar Niyazi, Ashley Linden, Mirella Di Lorenzo
pmc-12467538.description: Effective glucose monitoring is paramount for patients with diabetes to effectively manage their condition and prevent health complications. Electrochemical sensors for glucose monitoring have key advantages over other systems, including cost-effectiveness, miniaturisation and portability, enabling the design of compact and wearable devices. Typically, enzymes are used in these sensors, with the limitations of poor stability and high cost.

pmc-13672773.creator: Yi Lu, Xixi Wang, Cuike Yin, Jiaxuan Wang, Shaoqing Guo, Zihan Wang, Jing Zhou, Mengyuan Cui, Xiaoxia Cheng, Lei Zhang, Changjiang Qin
pmc-13672773.description: Chronic colitis is a major risk factor for colorectal cancer (CRC), particularly for colitis-associated colorectal cancer (CAC), where persistent inflammation drives the transition from mucosal injury to malignant transformation. Accumulating evidence indicates that gut microbiota dysbiosis, epithelial barrier disruption, microbial translocation, chronic immune activation, and aberrant inflammatory signaling collectively contribute to CAC initiation and progression.
